# Skills Index

## Core Skills

| Skill | When to Use |
| --- | --- |
| [allocation-free-audio](./allocation-free-audio/SKILL.md) | Keep the DxAudio play loop allocation-free on Unity's Mono - the facts about foreach, strings, sorted collections, closures, and pooling that change a per-play allocation, plus the sweep checklist for a new audio path. Use when optimizing a play, update, duck, or music path, or when an allocation test fails. |
| [create-unity-meta](./create-unity-meta/SKILL.md) | Generate correct Unity .meta files for new files and folders in the DxAudio package, including which paths Unity ignores and which importer blocks to use. Use whenever creating, moving, renaming, or deleting any visible file or folder. |
| [formatting-and-linting](./formatting-and-linting/SKILL.md) | Run CSharpier, Prettier, pre-commit, and the DxAudio Python lint gate; fix format-check or lint failures. Use when formatting code, adding a hook, or when a commit is rejected by csharpier, dotnet-tool-restore, or a lint step. |
| [llm-attribution](./llm-attribution/SKILL.md) | Disclose LLM-generated GitHub content, never auto-respond to outside contributors, and separate bot leads from human directives when reading review feedback. Use when posting or drafting any GitHub issue, comment, PR body, or review, or when acting on review feedback. |
| [manage-skills](./manage-skills/SKILL.md) | Create, edit, validate, and index Agent Skills in .llm/skills for DxAudio - frontmatter rules, category values, the generated index, size limits, and the lint commands that enforce all of them. Use when adding a skill, changing a skill description, editing .llm/context.md, or when lint:llm reports index drift or invalid frontmatter. |
| [plan-hygiene](./plan-hygiene/SKILL.md) | Keep PLAN.md lean - ordered open tasks, blockers, and acceptance criteria only. Move standing rules to context/skills and completed work to progress/ logs. Use when editing PLAN.md, ending a session, or removing plan bloat. |

| [simple-writing](./simple-writing/SKILL.md) | Write user-facing copy in Simplified Technical English - short, direct, active sentences for PRs, commits, issues, comments, and CHANGELOG entries. Use when writing or editing any text a human reads in this repo. |
